title: がっかりツインテール

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm supposed to meet with Daiwa Scarlet first thing this morning, but…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sigh… This is driving me crazy. No matter how many times I tie it, I can't get my hair right.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yes! There is! It has to be just like how my mom taught me to do it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ugh! I can't focus like this! I'll be back once I fix it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Daiwa Scarlet is unable to focus when her hair isn't perfect.
